title: console open asks the same resource several times: environment-entitlements ×3 on the cloud pricing page (one fetch per hook instance), get-session ×2 and runtime/config ×2 on every open
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 (the control plane's console open: 13 s to the last API response on staging, 30 calls with duplicates) cannot meet its acceptance (a splash under 4 s, a call budget) from cloud. The os-dev on that card measured one full console open on a local control plane at framework `f7e836da1ed3` / objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`, with Chromium and CDP initiator stacks mapped through source maps, on SQLite and on Postgres behind a 50 ms round trip (report `6225536289` on cloud#2914; every call's table is in the Attribution section of PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2941). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: the 74 most recent open objectui issues carry no card on `useEnvironmentEntitlements`, `auth-preflight` or `runtime/config` duplicates.

## Measured (one warm open, objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`)

1. **`GET /api/v1/cloud/environment-entitlements` ×3 on the pricing page, plus a fourth reader.**
   - `packages/app-shell/src/environment/useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts:67` fetches once per hook instance.
   - The pricing page mounts three `CloudPlanStatus.tsx:62` instances, one per plan card (`cloud:plan-status`, cloud `service-tenant/src/pages/pricing.page.ts:278`).
   - `console/home/CloudOnboardingNext.tsx:102` keeps its own copy, and `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.tsx:54` is a fourth reader.
   - Chrome serializes identical in-flight GETs: the second request is sent 2 ms after the first one's response headers. So the three calls cost three times the route's latency in series, and the third is the pricing page's last response.
2. **`GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` ×2 before the first app render.** The first is `apps/console/src/lib/auth-preflight.ts:86`, awaited in `main.tsx:76-80`. The second is `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx:234` via `createAuthClient.ts:471`. Each costs 11 queries, 389 ms at 50 ms RTT (see the framework card on the session prelude).
3. **`GET /api/v1/runtime/config` ×2, the second awaited before render.** `apps/console/index.html:85` publishes the in-flight promise, but `:86-89` drops it on settle, about 600 ms before the bundle asks. So `packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts:373` always refetches.

## Done when

- **One request per resource per open.** One organisation-keyed in-flight/settled entitlements resource in app-shell is shared by all four readers.
- **The preflight's session answer is handed to `AuthProvider`.**
- **The early-branding `runtime/config` body is kept** for the page's lifetime.
- **A test per item** counts the requests one mount issues.

These files are unchanged on objectui `main` `a8add5c711` (`AuthProvider.tsx` changed by 14 lines; re-read before fixing).

Dedupe words: environment-entitlements duplicate, useEnvironmentEntitlements in-flight, get-session twice boot, auth-preflight duplicate session, runtime/config twice, applyEarlyBranding inflight.
